create_transformers_engine: create a TransformersObjectDetectionEngine with options, model config, and accelerator options
initialize_transformers_engine: initialize the TransformersObjectDetectionEngine to load the model on the target device
run_transformers_predict_batch: run predict_batch on the TransformersObjectDetectionEngine with a list of ObjectDetectionEngineInput items
resolve_transformers_device: resolve the PyTorch device for the TransformersObjectDetectionEngine from accelerator options
resolve_transformers_dtype: resolve the PyTorch dtype for the TransformersObjectDetectionEngine from options or model config
